remarks: Steps from the sand. Fewer than 500 feet from the shoreline. This is the one you stop scrolling for. One of the rare newly built single-family homes this close to the water, this Newport Beach gem sits so near the ocean, "beach hair" might just become your permanent look. A showcase of modern coastal luxury, this stunning residence offers 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and 2,855 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, plus a jaw-dropping third-floor oasis that redefines what outdoor living actually means.
